custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the tail tip and the background. AI models often struggle with thin, curved appendages like tails, leading to melting or fusion with the ground plane. Verify if the 'paw' at the bottom right is anatomically plausible or if it is a distorted mass. Check if the stripe pattern flows logically across the body curvature without sudden discontinuities.
